name: public-pool
description: Run your own solo MINING POOL with web UI using public-pool & public-pool-ui. This Unraid template supports custom IP, ports, and direct Bitcoin node integration. ***** IMPORTANT NETWORK INFORMATION: ***** The External IP Address field must be set to the IP address where miners will connect to your pool. - If using bridge network (default): This should be your Unraid server's IP address - If using host network: This should be your Unraid server's IP address - If using custom network: This should be the IP you assigned to the container The ports shown below (3333, 3334, 8080) are used internally and can be mapped to different ports on your host if needed. Standard web UI access will be http://YOUR-Unraid-IP:8080

paths.name: AppData Path (persistent data)
paths.description: Directory where Public Pool stores shares, stats and worker data.

paths.name: Database Path
paths.description: Directory where the SQLite database is stored.

ports.name: Stratum Port
ports.description: Mining port for stratum connections. Miners will connect to YOUR-EXTERNAL-IP:3333 (or the port you map this to)

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the web UI. Access via http://YOUR-EXTERNAL-IP:8080 (or the port you map this to)

variables.name: Bitcoin RPC URL
variables.description: RPC URL of your Bitcoin node (e.g. http://192.168.1.100)

variables.name: Bitcoin RPC Port
variables.description: RPC port of your Bitcoin node (default: 8332)

variables.name: Bitcoin ZMQ Host
variables.description: ZMQ address of your Bitcoin node (e.g. tcp://192.168.1.100:28334)

variables.name: External IP Address
variables.description: IMPORTANT: Set this to YOUR unRAID server's IP address (or the IP where miners will connect). Required for UI to display miners correctly.

variables.name: Pool Identifier
variables.description: Custom name for your pool (e.g. Home-Pool, Unraid-Pool)

variables.name: Bitcoin Network
variables.description: Bitcoin network to use (mainnet or testnet)

variables.name: Enable HTTPS for API
variables.description: Set to 'true' to enable HTTPS. Default is 'false' (HTTP only). Enable only if you have a proper reverse proxy or certificate setup. Only enable HTTPS if you know what you're doing.
